info.title: CGS Games API
info.description: Discover community Card Game Simulator games. Public reads require no authentication. Publishing and deletion use Firebase ID tokens and a user profile with a username. API errors retain the legacy error string and add code, message, and hint. GET routes also support HEAD; OPTIONS lists allowed methods. Unknown API paths return JSON 404; unsupported methods return JSON 405 with Allow. Select major version 1 with API-Version: 1 (also the default). Unsupported versions return 400. Breaking changes require a new major version; at least 90 days notice precedes retirement using Deprecation (RFC 9745), Sunset (RFC 8594), and a migration Link. Version 1 has no scheduled retirement. See /developers#versioning.

get.summary: Read cached Grand Archive spoiler card data
get.description: Normally reads the assembled cache. Rate limited to 10 requests per minute per client IP per running instance. Operators may use warm=1 with the separate GATCG_WARM_TOKEN Bearer secret in production; a Firebase ID token does not grant this access. Unauthorized nocache=1 is ignored. warm runs can take up to 240 seconds and are not rate limited.

parameters.name: warm
parameters.description: Operator-only cache rebuild; requires the warmToken security scheme in production.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Re-run OCR from scratch. Only applies with warm=1.

parameters.name: nocache
parameters.description: Operator-only assembled cache bypass, preserving the OCR cache. Ignored without operator authorization.

200.description: Spoiler cards in a data array. Pending OCR may leave effect_raw empty.

RateLimit-Policy.description: IETF draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 quota policy. Present for normal rate-limited reads, not authorized warm runs.

RateLimit.description: IETF draft structured field: r is remaining requests; t is seconds until reset. Per IP per running instance. Normal rate-limited reads only.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Legacy absolute reset time (ISO 8601), unlike the relative t in RateLimit.
